titulo: CRUZANDO FRONTEIRAS, RC PORTO UNIÃO UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA FAZ VISITA À ROTARY CLUB MILANO FIERA PORTA NUOVA EM MILÃO-IT
resumo: Na noite de 29/04/26  tivemos a honra de participar de uma reunião do Rotary Club Milano Fiera Porta Nuova, em Milão 🇮🇹, onde fomos recebidos com enorme carinho e hospitalidade. A noite foi marcada por uma importante palestra conduzida por Gianni Guidotti, abordando um dos maiores compromissos do Rotary International: a erradicação da poliomielite no mundo. Também foi reforçada a importância do engajamento dos companheiros na PolioPlus Society, fortalecendo ainda mais esse movimento global. On March 14, 2026, we participated in the President-Elect Training, promoted by Rotary and held in the city of Campos Novos/SC. Representing our club, our partner Stefan Kolb was present, who will assume the presidency of the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória in the 2026–2027 term.

titulo: VISIT TO THE ROTARY CLUB OF CANOINHAS
resumo: On the night of February 18, 2026, colleagues Thiago Jorge Iwanko, Daniela Bochnia Iwanko and Stefan Kolb were present at the meeting of the Rotary Club of Canoinhas, in a moment of companionship, exchange of ideas and sharing of experiences between the clubs.

titulo: REVITALIZATION ROTARY MILESTONE OF RC PORTO UNIAO - UNIAO DA VITORIA
resumo: In 2025, work began on revitalizing the Rotary Landmark, adapting it to Rotary's new identity and public image standards. After work was completed, the revitalized landmark was officially reopened on January 15, 2025.

We participate in the activities of the football project developed in the Vice-King community, an initiative that began during the presidency of comrade Marcos Sauran and which continues to contribute to the development and integration of children and young people in the community.

In December, we delivered boxes of chocolates to CMEI São Braz, bringing joy to 108 children and reinforcing the true spirit of Christmas: solidarity, care, unity and the commitment to serving others.
